div.p: Park Street connects Little Lonsdale and La Trobe streets between King and William streets. The first date of occupation for the street was in 1866. In 1891, there were only two residents in Park Street. The Royal Mint Hotel was located on the west end of Park Street in 1910. By 1920, the Flinders Lane Umbrella Factory was located in Park Street, as well as wholesale confectioners and wine merchants.
